tax.text: Gooden introduced legislation to exclude restored Social Security benefits for public-sector retirees from taxable income.
tax.quote: The No Tax on Restored Benefits Act guarantees that they keep every dollar of the benefits they have rightfully earned

trade.text: He introduced a bipartisan bill allowing qualifying goods from U.S. foreign-trade zones to be exported duty-free to Mexico and Canada.
trade.quote: This bill cuts red tape, boosts U.S. exports, and strengthens trade with Mexico and Canada to keep good-paying jobs in America.

debt.text: He supported and worked to pass legislation repealing Social Security benefit reductions affecting certain public servants.
debt.quote: From the day I first campaigned for Congress in 2018, I vowed to fight tirelessly until this unfair system was corrected.

schools.text: He rejects a uniform federal approach to education and supports policies empowering states and parental choice.
schools.quote: A one-size-fits-all, big government approach to education does not work. Putting in place policies that empower states and parent choice do.

immigration.text: He says he worked to secure the southern border, remove criminal immigrants in the country illegally, and support Border Patrol and ICE.
immigration.quote: I have proudly worked alongside President Trump to secure our southern border and remove criminal illegal aliens from our country.

guns.text: He voted against a universal-background-check bill and pledged to protect the buying, keeping, and selling of firearms.
guns.quote: I voted NO on this bill and continue to stand behind my commitment to protect the right of my constituents and all Americans to buy, keep and sell firearms.

abortion.text: He opposes government proposals that promote or fund abortion services.
abortion.quote: I am proudly pro-life, and I will do everything I can to fight against government proposals that promote or otherwise fund abortion services.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He introduced legislation protecting elementary schools from federal penalties if they declined to implement federal guidance on sex education or gender identity.
gender.quote: Elementary school teachers should not be sexualizing or confusing our children by teaching them an un-scientific gender identity and sex education curriculum.

cannabis.text: He said voters in his district were not ready for full marijuana legalization and later voted against federal legalization legislation.
cannabis.quote: I don't believe that the average conservative Republican primary voter in Henderson County is ready for the full-on legalization of marijuana.

health.text: He favors free-market health-care policies intended to lower costs and increase patient choice over socialized medicine.
health.quote: Applying free-market solutions to reduce costs, improve outcomes, and increase patient choice will allow all Americans to receive affordable care options.

energy.text: He supports an all-of-the-above energy policy, fewer regulations, and free-market policies to lower consumer costs and preserve energy production.
energy.quote: Texas resources are essential to achieving American energy dominance and having an all-the-above approach to powering our country creates jobs, lowers costs to consumers, strengthens our national security, and ensures our energy needs are met for generations to come.

voting.text: He demanded full ballot audits in four states before Congress certified the 2020 presidential election results.
voting.quote: There must be a full audit of every ballot in states like Georgia, Arizona, Michigan, and Pennsylvania where there are widespread reports of fraud and data abnormalities.

tax.text: She supports raising taxes on billionaires and large corporations and says the revenue should fund schools, health care, infrastructure, disaster response, and other public needs.
tax.quote: I support major tax reform, especially raising taxes on billionaires and large corporations.

debt.text: She supports expanding Social Security rather than reducing its benefits.
debt.quote: $25 Minimum Wage & Expanded Social Security Workers deserve fair compensation for their labor!

housing.text: She supports constructing more affordable housing and acting against corporate landlords holding homes vacant.
housing.quote: Build more affordable housing units and crack down

schools.text: She pledges to protect public schools and oppose voucher programs that divert their resources.
schools.quote: fight to protect public schools, stop voucher schemes

safety.text: She supports funding social workers and using nonviolent responses to crime.
safety.quote: social workers and find nonviolent solutions to crime.

immigration.text: She supports replacing ICE with accountable immigration services that offer a pathway to citizenship.
immigration.quote: humane, accountable immigration services that provide a pathway to citizenship.

abortion.text: She promises to protect and restore reproductive rights.
abortion.quote: protect and restore reproductive rights, strengthen rural hospitals

health.text: She supports a universal, publicly funded Medicare-for-All system.
health.quote: I support Medicare-for-All. The United States is the only

energy.text: She supports major investment in renewable energy and battery storage.
energy.quote: I support real investment in renewable energy, wind, solar, and battery storage

voting.text: She supports restoring the Voting Rights Act as part of protecting voting rights.
voting.quote: restoring the Voting Rights Act and overturning Citizens United
